instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph, medium shot, side-angle view. In a cozy bedroom on a bed with yellow sheets, the man with a beard (R2) in a denim shirt and jeans lies on his back on a white pillow, smiling up at the baby girl (R1) in a white shirt and jeans with pink hair clips. He holds her aloft above his chest with both hands. The baby lies horizontally, looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. The scene is illuminated by soft natural light from the side, creating warm yellow and blue tones.
